direction: Use the original first Harry audition: tense, self-serious, worried and firm. Do not use the more frantic refinement.
sample_prompt:
[quietly] Last night I had that nightmare again. My precious sunflower, withered, dead. Murdered.
[tense] I don’t know what to do anymore. I know it’s going to happen tonight, I just know. So I have to find the murderer first.
Oh, my sunflower, the light of my days. My loyal companion... Even in my darkest hour I kept nurturing it, and that’s all that kept me sane.
[worried] I don’t want it to die... I don’t want to be alone...
[firmly] I have to keep it alive.
